baseline_telemetry.scope: Missing baseline telemetry is a comparison limit; no velocity reconstruction or zero imputation is performed.

interpretation.solver: CPU synchronized solver_ms sums from 120 complete frames; paired ratios describe shared WDDM observations.
interpretation.phase: Native CUDA-event stage envelopes include device work, host submission gaps and device idle; they are not pure GPU kernel costs.
interpretation.addition: No CUDA API waits, CPU scopes, Graph capture time or exit assembly is added to solver/stage totals. Exit assembly and uncovered differences are reported separately.
interpretation.workload: Direction/PCG differences and missing baseline energy/backtrack telemetry limit attribution to identical numerical trajectories.
interpretation.quality: Actual Stiff velocity and full PCG breakdown telemetry are absent; no reconstructed velocity, accepted-path CCD certification, material tolerance relaxation or promotion of the prior failed quality gate.
